name.ja: メアリー・シーコール

overview.en: Mary Seacole was a Jamaican-British nurse and businesswoman who provided care to wounded soldiers during the Crimean War despite racial prejudice.

early_life.en: Born Mary Jane Grant in Kingston, Jamaica, she learned traditional medicine and nursing from her mother and gained experience treating cholera and other diseases across the Caribbean.

impact.en: She overcame racial barriers to provide frontline medical care during the Crimean War and her autobiography became an important document of Black British history.

event.en: Traveled to Crimea at her own expense after being rejected by the War Office
Established the 'British Hotel' near the front lines to treat wounded soldiers
Published her autobiography, Wonderful Adventures of Mrs. Seacole

title.en: Wonderful Adventures of Mrs. Seacole in Many Lands

description.en: Autobiography describing her travels and medical work in the Crimean War

text.en: I trust I have made the reader understand that I did not only nurse the sick, but I was a doctress.
